octave_convention_note: Ample displays C0 for MIDI note 24 (standard C1). All note numbers in this file are raw MIDI note numbers.

pinch_harmonic.note: SC has PH as a separate keyswitch (B-1), unlike Eclipse where PH is velocity 127 of Sustain.

sustain.velocity_layer_note: Velocity 127 triggers Pop or Pinch Harmonic depending on Settings. SC has simpler velocity model than Eclipse (2 layers vs 5).

palm_mute.note: When C0+D0 both active (doubled keyswitches): high velocity = Sustain, low velocity = Palm Mute.

legato_slide.slide_smoother: For slides over 2 frets, destination note velocity determines slide speed. Higher velocity = faster.
legato_slide.note: Reverts to previous articulation automatically after slide. Poly legato: multiple start notes on different strings trigger slides of the same interval.

hammer_pull.note: Press highest note of destination for Hammer-On; lowest for Pull-Off. Reverts to previous articulation when destination note ends. Poly legato: multiple start notes on different strings trigger HP of the same interval.

slide_guitar.note: SC-specific articulation not present in Eclipse. High velocity triggers a slide ornament; low velocity triggers a sustained slide note.

string_force.note: SC string force uses G0-C1 (31-36), different from Eclipse's F#-1~B-1 (18-23).

capo_force.note: SC calls this 'Position Assignment' (§2.13.2). C#1 activates, then E1-A#2 selects position 0-18. Each position covers 5 frets (12 frets in Melody mode). Different from Eclipse which uses G#0 activation + C1-F#2 positions.

note_repeater.label: D6
note_repeater.note_desc: Press D6 to repeat notes being played. Multiple notes supported.

open_string_first.label: G#6
open_string_first.note_desc: Standard tuning: E A D G B E

mode_descriptions.melody_mode: Covers three octaves, suitable for melodic playing
mode_descriptions.chord_mode: Each position spans five frets, suitable for chord playing

play_modes.instrument: Constrained by real instrument rules (one note per string at a time)
play_modes.keyboard: Not limited by real instrument rules; disables auto legato

doubled_guitars.description: Two guitars (left and right) can trigger different samples. Knob adjusts stereo width.

stroke_noise.description: Strummed noise generated automatically for polyphonic notes.

vibrato_wheel.note: When vibrato depth in Settings >= 0.75, vibrato noise is triggered.
